title: What a finished session should show
decision: Compact cards that open a structured review, or keep the loose list.

options.label: Leave the page as it is

blakely.reason: The review is what the candidate feels

graham.reason: A review that does not change the next rep is decoration

buffett.reason: Readiness numbers must stay off the screen

musk.reason: Delete the quote dump if it repeats the note

brief: Sessions lists rows and a loose detail. The founder wants a consistent review: overview, per question, delivery, patterns, next practice. No grades.
assumptions: A session is a handful of answers
STAR can be described in words without a score
